steps.executor_prompt: Open the exact target Default Browser and go to login.live.com and verify the current controller-owned UI belongs to it before entering anything. For a browser target, use DuckDuckGo, navigate to the explicit destination domain in Default Browser and go to login.live.com, and clear any stale browser session first. Do not treat a launcher, browser chrome/new-tab UI, auth app, or another service as the target. If the target is already authenticated, sign out or reset that target session and re-observe the login screen before proceeding; a pre-existing session cannot pass. Enter {user} as username and not needed as password when those fields are required. Request the OTP using the target's request/send control; if login must be pressed first to reveal that control, do so, then request the OTP. The selected method must produce a transferable one-time code in Gmail; an Authenticator approval, number-matching prompt, push notification, passkey, or other code-less challenge is not an OTP and cannot satisfy this step. If the target initially offers one of those methods, use its Other ways to sign in, Use a verification code, or equivalent target-owned control to select code delivery through Gmail; if no compatible code-delivery method exists, report failure. An OTP field that was already visible is not proof that a fresh code was requested. Stop only after a new request made in this step is confirmed by target-owned UI such as an OTP-sent message, requesting/sent state, or a newly displayed code-entry challenge. Verify that the displayed delivery destination or auth-source identity matches Gmail and {user} when available. Do not submit an old or guessed code.
steps.auditor_prompt: AUDIT ONLY. Do not tap, type, swipe, or change anything on screen. Inspect the CURRENT screen state and decide whether this task was actually completed successfully: The exact target UI confirms that this attempt freshly requested/sent a transferable OTP to the correct {auth_app} source or newly advanced to a code-entry challenge after credentials were entered; push approval and number matching do not pass. Do not rely on memory or on what an earlier agent claimed -- judge only from what is visible right now. If you cannot clearly confirm success, treat it as not passed. Report your verdict as structured output.
